Thanks! Yeah, I had ran a bunch myself, but not as many as you managed to

reviews.author: Gregory (Meta) (author)
reviews.summary: Author acknowledged that the self-tests are not meant for long-term testing but rather to define contracts, and agreed to refactor them into a larger session.
reviews.raw_body:
It's there to show the work more than to merge, but the long-term goal
here is to feed these tests into a larger session that does the polish.

Fixes: -> Tested-by: -> Analyze -> Proper Self-tests -> Upstream
                                   Or unit-tests :]

Usually these tests are not things we want to test for long term,
but they do help define the contracts we DO want to test.

~Gregory

-- 
~Gregory

2026-10-26.patch_summary: This patch series addresses various issues in the mm/shmem module, including swap entry handling, quota management, and ACL enforcement. The patches fix problems such as OOM conditions, lost quota limits, and EPERM errors when accessing sealed memory files. Additionally, the series resolves hangs caused by unkillable processes and incorrect swap count underflows. The patches were tested on an x86_64 kernel with KASAN and lockdep enabled in a virtme-ng VM, and all issues reproduced on the base kernel were fixed with the series applied.
